summary: Backend PDF import regression passes (250 tasks + private source_path). Frontend import flow still blocked: review/save/switch cannot complete on preview due import review render failure after upload.

Investigate Expo preview instability logs (Metro disconnect during upload run) to ensure deterministic UI testability.
